description: This file defines the MailFormatHelper class, which provides utility methods for formatting email messages, including HTML to plain text conversion, line wrapping, and URL handling within the Drupal CMS.

classes.name: MailFormatHelper
classes.description: A utility class for formatting mail messages, including HTML to plain text conversion, line wrapping, and URL management.

methods.name: wrapMail
methods.description: Performs RFC 3676 format=flowed soft wrapping for email text, handling line breaks and indentation.

methods.name: htmlToText
methods.description: Converts HTML content into plain text, supporting specific tags and footnotes for URLs.

methods.name: wrapMailLine
methods.description: Helper callback to wrap individual lines, respecting MIME headers and line length limits.

methods.name: htmlToMailUrls
methods.description: Tracks URLs in HTML content, replacing them with tokens and maintaining a list of URLs.

methods.name: htmlToTextClean
methods.description: Replaces non-quotation markers in indentation strings with spaces for text formatting.

methods.name: htmlToTextPad
methods.description: Pads the last line of text with a specified character to a fixed width, used for headers and separators.
